data.title: Thais ready for Games test, says coach
data.description: Natipong Srithong-in has declared Thailand's women's football team ready for the Asian Games, despite a preparation period he admits was far from ideal.

data.title: Duplantis delivers masterclass for Ultimate pole vault win
data.description: BUDAPEST - World and Olympic champion Armand 'Mondo' Duplantis delivered a faultless display of pole vaulting to seal victory on the opening day of the Ultimate Championship in Budapest on Friday.

data.title: 'Desperate' Sabalenka books US Open title clash with Rybakina
data.description: NEW YORK — Aryna Sabalenka stormed past Jessica Pegula in straight sets on Thursday to keep her bid for a rare US Open three-peat on track, booking a championship showdown with Elena Rybakina.

data.title: Manchester derby poses Maresca's first big test, Chelsea aim to end Hull Honeymoon
data.description: MANCHESTER — Enzo Maresca faces his first major test since stepping into Pep Guardiola's shoes as City visit United in the Manchester derby on Sunday, while Arsenal aim to extend their flawless start at Sunderland.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rambolek stripped of title on scale after missing weight
data.description: Thailand’s Rambolek Chor Ajalaboon has lost his ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai world title on the scale after missing weight in Bangkok – leaving Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri as the only man who can claim the vacant belt at The Inner Circle 30.

data.title: Kieran opts out of squad for LA push
data.description: Thai-American distance runner Kieran Tuntivate has spoken of his regret at missing the 20th Asian Games in Japan, revealing he turned down a place in Thailand's athletics squad to focus on his marathon ambitions instead.

data.title: Man United, Bayern cruise as Como make dream Champions League start
data.description: PARIS - Manchester United celebrated their return to the Champions League with a 4-0 thrashing of Sabah on Thursday, as Cesc Fabregas's Como impressed on their debut in Europe's premier club competition.

data.title: Suchai upbeat despite uphill trek in Japan
data.description: Tennis chief Suchai Pornchaisakudom believes that the Asian Games competition will be challenging but remains confident that Thai athletes can pull off a strong showing in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: Thunder Castle begin life under Silva
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United return to Thai League 1 action today, hosting Chiang Rai United at the Chang Arena in new head coach Mario Silva's first match in charge since his appointment this week.

data.title: Indian trailblazer seeks Asian Games weightlifting glory
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian weightlifter Mirabai Chanu says she “will not let go” of the chance to round off a glittering career with an elusive Asian Games medal, saying her goal feels “so close”.

data.title: Rybakina books US Open semi-final against Gauff
data.description: NEW YORK - Elena Rybakina ended Zheng Qinwen’s spirited US Open run on Wednesday, guaranteeing her rise to world No. 1 as she booked a semi-final showdown with Coco Gauff.

data.title: Thais secure two berths for track worlds
data.description: Thailand have booked two places at the UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai next month, after the national sprint team and a lone rider in the men's 1km time trial earned qualification on the back of strong recent form.

data.title: Spikers continue winning run, reach Asian quarters
data.description: Thailand claimed their third straight win in the preliminary phase of the AVC Men's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 in Japan and qualified for the quarter-finals as Pool C winners.

data.title: Buriram pick Silva, Sailors land Jackson
data.description: Buriram United have appointed Mario Silva as head coach, turning to the former Porto youth-team architect to lead the Thai League champions into the 2026-27 season, as his predecessor Mark Jackson resurfaces at Singapore's Lion City Sailors.

data.title: PSG thrash Slovan in Champions League opener, Liverpool down Atletico
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Holders Paris Saint-Germain made a smooth start to their bid for a third consecutive Champions League title as Ferran Torres scored a hat-trick in a 6-1 rout of Slovan Bratislava on Wednesday, while Liverpool came from behind to beat Atletico Madrid.

data.title: Sabalenka edges Noskova to keep US Open treble bid alive
data.description: NEW YORK - Two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka rallied in the final set to beat Linda Noskova on Tuesday and reach a sixth straight US Open semi-final.

data.title: Record rain forces Asian Games athletes to evacuate accommodation
data.description: TOKYO — Hundreds of Asian Games athletes in Japan were briefly evacuated from their accommodation as record rainfall lashed host city Nagoya, with competition beginning on Thursday.

data.title: The golfer who inspired my journey
data.description: Brian Huggett was my inspiration in becoming a professional golfer. When I was a young lad, our paths crossed as his father was the club professional of my local golf course. Brian was a prominent tournament player, winning many tournaments and finish third in the 1962 British Open and second in 1965. He played in many Ryder Cup tournaments and was synonymous with holing, arguably, golf's most pressurised putt when he thought the three feet in front of him was to win the 1969 Ryder Cup outright. He was playing Billy Casper and was thinking that the last match playing behind him was being won by Tony Jacklin, who was playing Jack Nicklaus.

data.title: Aussie Opetaia in Sin City as he chases unfinished business
data.description: Jai Opetaia will take the work from his recent Phuket training camp to one of boxing's biggest stages this weekend when he faces Noel Mikaelian at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.

data.title: Proadprans to take over as SAT chief from Oct 1
data.description: The cabinet approved the Ministry of Tourism and Sports' proposal to appoint Proadprans Samarnmit as the governor of the Sports Authority of Thailand, government deputy spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said on Tuesday.

data.title: Thais refuse to let absences hinder bid
data.description: Thailand's U23 squad continued their preparations on Tuesday for the men's football tournament of the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, with midfielder Thanakrit Chotmuangpak stressing that the absence of two key figures will not derail the team's ambitions.

data.title: Real Madrid win Champions League opener as Haaland stars for Man City
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Jose Mourinho got off to a winning start on his return to the Champions League with Real Madrid on Tuesday as the Spanish giants beat Inter Milan 2-1, while Erling Haaland scored twice in Manchester City's victory at Porto.

data.title: World Cup final scorer Torres leads Ballon d'Or nominees
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Ferran Torres, whose goal against Argentina won the World Cup for Spain in July, leads a 30-man list for the men's Ballon d'Or revealed on Tuesday.

data.title: Super Bowl rematch kicks off NFL season as league expands global reach
data.description: LOS ANGELES - The most ambitious NFL season in history kicks off on Wednesday with a Super Bowl rematch, an unprecedented global schedule and a clutch of contenders plotting to dethrone the Seattle Seahawks.

data.title: Bissoli heroics give Buriram winning start
data.description: Buriram United made a winning start under interim head coach Emerson Pereira, beating Sukhothai 3-1 in the Thai League 1 opener at Thung Talay Luang Stadium on Sunday night.

data.title: Comeback queen Zheng strikes again for US Open quarter-final berth
data.description: NEW YORK - Olympic gold medallist Zheng QinWen pulled off another incredible comeback Monday to stun six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek and reach the US Open quarter-finals.

data.title: 'Super-human' Alcaraz books US Open quarter-final clash with Shelton
data.description: NEW YORK — Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz posted his most convincing win in his injury return at the US Open, downing Tommy Paul in straight sets on Sunday to line up a quarter-final clash with Ben Shelton.

data.title: Ohtani 'unlikely' to pitch again this season, says Dodgers manager
data.description: LOS ANGELES, United States — Los Angeles Dodgers two-way superstar Shohei Ohtani is unlikely to pitch again this season, team manager Dave Roberts said Sunday.

data.title: PSG go for three in a row as Champions League returns
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Another UEFA Champions League season gets going this week with the beginning of the league phase as Paris Saint-Germain bid to join the tiny band of clubs to have won the competition three years running.

data.title: Sensational Antonelli wins Italian GP from back of grid
data.description: MONZA (ITALY) - Championship leader Kimi Antonelli delivered one of the most sensational triumphs in the long history of the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday when he became the first home winner in 60 years after starting from 19th on the grid.

data.title: Buriram, Jackson part ways
data.description: <p>Thai League 1 coaches are usually given time to fail before the axe falls -- sackings and resignations tend to pile up as a season wears on. This time, the upheaval has arrived before a ball has even been kicked.</p>

data.title: Hail the Hiro: Thai teenager bags historic ISU medal
data.description: <p>Hiro Kaewtathip made history by becoming the first Thai figure skater to win a medal at an ISU Grand Prix event.</p>

data.title: No rest for Kingdom's riders as bigger Asian Games test looms
data.description: <p>Thai sprinters raced out of their skins to spring a surprise at the Track Asia Cup 2026, lifting the Kingdom to fourth spot in the continental rankings -- but there was little time to savour the achievement, with the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya bearing down fast.</p>

data.title: Arsenal deliver statement fightback to end Chelsea's flying start
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal delivered an emphatic response to Chelsea's emergence as potential Premier League title contenders with a 2-1 win that ended their rivals' unbeaten start on Sunday.
